Job Summary
This is a legal intake and lead conversion role for a remote law firm specializing in criminal defense and family law. The Intake Specialist serves as the first point of contact for potential clients, responding to inquiries, qualifying leads, scheduling consultations, and helping convert prospective clients into retained clients. This role blends customer service, sales, and client relationship management in a performance-driven environment.
 Expected Realistic Duties
 Answer inbound phone calls, emails, texts, and web inquiries from prospective clients. 
 Conduct intake interviews to determine if potential clients meet firm criteria. 
 Explain legal consultation processes and next steps. 
 Schedule consultations with attorneys or sales representatives. 
 Follow up with leads who have not yet retained the firm. 
 Make outbound calls to warm leads. 
 Build rapport with individuals experiencing stressful legal situations. 
 Maintain accurate CRM records and client notes. 
 Track lead status, follow-ups, and conversion activity. 
 Meet response time, conversion, and client experience goals. 
 Coordinate handoffs between intake, sales, and legal teams.

other: This is not a traditional legal assistant role and does not require legal experience. The position functions more like a legal intake coordinator combined with an appointment setter and customer service representative. Success depends on quickly responding to inquiries, building trust with potential clients, qualifying leads, and scheduling consultations. Participants with call center, admissions, healthcare intake, insurance, sales support, customer service, or appointment-setting backgrounds are likely to perform well. The strongest candidates will be empathetic communicators who are comfortable handling sensitive conversations while maintaining performance goals and CRM accuracy.
